title: Uncomplicated Malaria in Pregnancy
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
Management of Malaria in Special Groups

blocks.text: In high-transmission areas (moderate to high immunity); malaria is usually asymptomatic in pregnancy or is associated with only mild, non-specific symptoms. (See section 5.1 above)

runs.text: In high-transmission areas (moderate to high immunity); malaria is usually asymptomatic in pregnancy or is associated with only mild, non-specific symptoms. (See section 5.1 above)

blocks.text: Artemether/Lumefantrine (ALU) is the recommended treatment of choice of a confirmed uncomplicated malaria to pregnant women in all trimesters. See table 5.1 above
